title: Card Tender Allowance on Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Labor
content:
How the purchase being delivered was paid sets a tender allowance on the labor fee for each television in a Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge at the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level. The tender is the one the purchase record under Northgate Purchases & Returns shows:

| Purchase paid with | Allowance off the labor fee for each television |
|---|---|
| The Northgate Visa | $15.00 |
| The Northgate Store Card | $5.00 |
| Any other tender | None |

The allowance comes off the labor fee for each television itself, so every amount worked out from the per-television labor fee is worked out from the lowered fee.

## Tender questions

**Which payment counts?** The tender of the purchase being delivered.

**Is the allowance per appointment or per television?** Per television: it lowers the labor fee of each television.

**Hypothetical.** A $200.00 labor fee for each television on a purchase paid with the Northgate Visa becomes $185.00 for each television; paid with the Northgate Store Card, $195.00; paid any other way, $200.00.
